_readme: Site-wide facts read by tools/build.js. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored. Run `npm run build` after editing.
name: Elephant Door
legal: (c) 2026 Elephant Door Studios LLC. All rights reserved.
_twitter: ALEX: the studio's Twitter handle with the @, e.g. "@elephantdoor", once the account is (re)activated. Empty = no twitter:site tag and no social line on the press page.
_default_image: The image link previews use when a page has no image of its own (1200x630 recommended). assets/og/placeholder.png is a flat purple card; ALEX: swap it for the capsule art when it lands.

analytics._readme: Privacy-friendly analytics. provider is "goatcounter" or "plausible"; code is the GoatCounter site code (the SUBDOMAIN part of https://SUBDOMAIN.goatcounter.com, chosen at signup) or, for Plausible, the domain added to the Plausible account (elephantdoorstudios.com). Empty code = no script on any page.

game.title: Warlock: Age of Entropy
game._based_in: ALEX: city / country for the press fact sheet, or leave empty to omit the line.
game._release_date: Planned date from the launch plan (fallback 2026-11-10). ALEX: confirm before pushing; it is not announced anywhere yet. Empty = omitted.
game.requirements: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11, 2 GHz dual-core, 4 GB RAM, any DirectX 11 GPU (integrated is fine), 200 MB, keyboard and mouse
game._steam_app_id: ALEX: the numeric Steam app ID once the store page exists (public by Oct 13). Empty = the itch embed stays and every Steam button and widget is left out.
game._steam_utm: Query string appended to every Steam link on the site; Steamworks > Marketing & Visibility > UTM Analytics reports visits, wishlists and purchases per tag. See README.md for the per-channel scheme.
game._trailer_youtube_id: ALEX: the YouTube video ID of the trailer (the part after v= or youtu.be/). Empty = the trailer sections stay hidden.
